name: Makino Milling Machine Co., Ltd.
summary: Makino Milling Machine Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture, sale, and maintenance of machine tools in Japan, Asia, the United States, Europe, and internationally. The company offers machining centers, NC electrical discharge machines (EDM), milling machines, FMS, CAD/CAM systems, and other products. It also provides horizontal 5-axis, 4-axis and vertical machining 3-axis and 5-axis and, graphite machining centers, wire EDM, sinker EDM, EDM hole drilling, and grinding machines; CNC machining monitoring programs; and automation solutions, including robot integration, linear pallet pool system, fixture plate handling system, pallet automation, and factory automation.
